title.zh: Colorlib Website Templates · 按用途和技术筛选后

description.zh: Follow current official LIVE PREVIEW href to the complete native Jackson template viewport; preserve original detail-page poster in old packet. Colorlib 的 Website Templates 入口提供团队制作的网站模板，按行业、页面类型和框架筛选，并将免费与付费设计放在同一资源库。Bootstrap 分类页提醒按具体产品查版本与依赖，当前 Jackson 原生预览首屏完整显示侧栏导航、人物照片、标题和下载入口。可先选用途再比较实际模板；Jackson 首屏不代表所有页面已探索，也不把一个模板报价或权益推广到整个库。

reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by Colorlib Website Templates (https://colorlib.com/wp/templates/).
Technology stack: css, javascript, tailwind.
Component specification: Follow current official LIVE PREVIEW href to the complete native Jackson template viewport; preserve original detail-page poster in old packet.


Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
